name: 11812-sharedprefix-dsv2lite-1gpu
model: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite -- the BASE checkpoint, not -Chat: the requests are raw text continuations and the base repo ships no chat template.
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 of one a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, EP off. One GPU, one node, no router and no external cache tier.
architecture: DeepseekV2ForCausalLM, MLA, 27 layers, 64 routed + 2 shared experts at top-6, 15.7B total / 2.4B active, bf16, ~31 GB of weights.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup the first 30%, bounded at 2000 requests with a 1200 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over `/v1/completions`, SINGLE TURN: one shared preamble of 768 tokens (`prefix_count: 1`) identical on every request, then a question of ~256 tokens (stdev 64, clamped 128-512), generating ~96 tokens (stdev 24, clamped 32-256). Seed 42.
purpose: A text completion service for analysts, where 32 concurrent users share one long standing preamble on a single GPU.
launch:
# ENGINE: sglang at commit 885cfca2732dd2fac9e4f76c4eacdcfafd4a5eee (v0.5.5-71-g885cfca2732).

model-path: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
trust-remote-code: true
tp-size: 1

# triton needs no runtime JIT of CUDA sources, so nothing on the serving path needs an nvcc
# toolchain to be present.
attention-backend: triton

chunked-prefill-size: 8192
context-length: 8192
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
random-seed: 42

# The prefix cache is ON: `disable-radix-cache` is deliberately unset. Do not write it as `false`
# instead -- a false boolean is dropped when the command line is built, so the line would read as
# a setting while doing nothing.
